mapper.sql: select a.agreement_id, a.supplier_id, a.agreement_no, a.sign_date, a.expire_date, a.file_name, a.file_url, a.status, a.renew_count, a.last_renew_date, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, s.supplier_name as supplier_name from jc_supplier_agreement a left join jc_supplier s on s.supplier_id = a.supplier_id
mapper.select:
a.del_flag = '0'
and a.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
and a.agreement_no like concat('%', #{agreementNo}, '%')
and a.status = #{status}
and date_format(a.expire_date, '%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime}, '%Y%m%d')
and date_format(a.expire_date, '%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime}, '%Y%m%d')
order by case a.status when '2' then 0 when '1' then 1 else 2 end, a.expire_date asc
where a.supplier_id = #{supplierId} order by a.sign_date desc
mapper.update: update jc_supplier_agreement set sign_date = curdate(), expire_date = #{newExpireDate}, status = '0', renew_count = renew_count + 1, last_renew_date = curdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where agreement_id = #{agreementId}
update jc_supplier_agreement set status = '3', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where agreement_id = #{agreementId}
update jc_supplier_agreement set del_flag = '1', update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where agreement_id = #{agreementId}
mapper.select: select max(agreement_no) from jc_supplier_agreement where agreement_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: update jc_supplier_agreement set status = case when expire_date < curdate() then '2' when expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{warnDays} day) then '1' else '0' end, update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and status <> '3' and status <> case when expire_date < curdate() then '2' when expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{warnDays} day) then '1' else '0' end
mapper.select: select sum(status in ('0','1')) as active, sum(status = '1') as expiring from jc_supplier_agreement where del_flag = '0'
